name: Sonoe Ikumi
source:
The wife of Komatsu’s older brother (Haruchika).
She said she wasn’t very good at romance and had missed her chance to get married, when Haruchika jokingly said, “If you don’t mind me, I’ll go out with you,”
which led them to start dating.
She’s actually quite skilled in bed, and Haruchika was completely smitten.
She’d heard from Haruchika that he had a cute younger brother, so she’d been interested in Komatsu for a while.

“I’m going to eat him. I won’t share him with anyone… I’m going to eat this boy all up myself.”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015168.html/]dlsite[/url]]
